text:
mike: Heads-up — Nightcap change window tomorrow 02:00 UTC for the v3.7 rollout. Freeze merges at 00:00 UTC. Quick checklist: canary, smoke, pin decision, rollback owners.

olivia: noted. i'm taking canary and smoke. i'll run the warmup at 01:30 UTC and post perf numbers. :thumbsup:

mike: thanks. canary will be 5% traffic for 20m, then 25% for 30m if stable. if p50 latency > 120ms or error rate +0.5% -> abort.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: env=prod target=v3.7-canary cohorts=5% duration=20m triggered_by=@mike

linda: pinning question — do we pin frontend clients to v3.7-compat or leave float? ops prefers pin for first hour.

mike: pin for 1h then unpin if metrics look good. add a release-note entry: "v3.7: incremental latency improvements, new batching knob".

olivia: adding smoke steps to the playbook now. plan: basic health endpoints, small load test (50rps), embeddings sanity check on sample prompts.

sre-ops: oncall assigned @oncall-today. rollback owners: @sre-ops will execute infra rollback, @mike will cut model pin, @linda will coordinate client rollback.

mike: rollback commands for quick reference (in case):
```
# roll back model to last stable
redwoodctl model rollback --env prod --to-tag v3.6-stable
# drain canary
redwoodctl traffic set --env prod --model v3.7-canary --pct 0
```

linda: adding a fail-open rule: if datastore errors spike, route 100% to v3.6 and alert sla-channel.

olivia: i'll post a short smoke results summary after warmup with these fields: p50, p95, errors, token cost delta.

mike: final pre-freeze asks: no merges after 00:00 UTC, all release notes in GH PR, tag owners in the rollcall doc. i'll be online from 01:45 to 03:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: reminder: code freeze starts in 8h. To request a hotfix exemption, open #eng-releases with APPROVAL from two leads.

sre-ops: i'll monitor infra dashboards and have rollback playbook pinned. ping here if anything noisy.

olivia: copy — will report metrics at 01:35 and 02:25. good luck team :rocket:

mike: thanks — quiet window checklist done. see y'all in the window. :white_check_mark:
